portalsFound.observation: Anonymous ArcGIS Online FeatureServer 'lotes' (Lotes-Sedapal): 276,848 lot polygons with district, block (mza) and lot fields, extent roughly eastern and central Lima. Copyright text credits SEDAPAL and Consorcio Servicios Integrales; the layer description says it is a utility-contract vector file at 1:1,000. Hosted by ArcGIS account dromeroOGIT, whose other items are Peruvian urban-planning layers marked for use by local governments and the housing ministry, but the account's institutional identity was not confirmed.
Geoportal Catastro Nacional hub loaded (HTTP 200) but its static HTML exposed no service URLs; search summaries mention GeoServices/WMS/WFS links that were not verified.

Instituto Catastral de Lima entry on the national SDI; WebFetch got HTTP 503 and curl failed, so unread. Search summaries say Lima cadastral cartography is at 1:1,000 and linked to SUNARP partida registral lookup.
SUNARP offers free graphic location of properties for registry queries, a per-lookup service rather than an open polygon list.

remainingUncertainty: This is a utility-derived layer republished by a third-party ArcGIS account, not shown to be an official cadastre, and no reuse terms were visible for it. Official cadastre from the Instituto Catastral de Lima, SUNARP or the national cadastre hub was not reached.
